literal: From ruin having removed those (bad things), having led on the path, at the time of ruin suffering sorrow is friendship.
translation: True friendship removes a friend from ruinous ways, guides them onto the right path, and shares their sorrow in times of unavoidable ruin.
modern: அழிவைத் தரும் செயல்களிலிருந்து நண்பனை விலக்கி, அவனை நல்ல வழியில் செலுத்தி, அவனுக்கு ஒரு துன்பம் வரும்போது அவனுடன் சேர்ந்து அத்துன்பத்தைப் பகிர்ந்துகொள்வதே உண்மையான நட்பாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the active and supportive nature of true friendship. The first half emphasizes moral guidance: a friend removes one from ruinous paths and steers them toward the right way. The second half highlights unwavering support during unavoidable hardships: if ruin still strikes, true friendship means sharing and enduring that sorrow together. The word 'உழப்பது' conveys a deep, shared toiling or suffering, showing that a friend does not abandon one in distress.
